summary.intent: Fix web E2E tests that were breaking due to upload changes causing Playwright strict mode violations (locators resolving to 2 elements) and ensure all upload-related E2E test suites pass locally against the staging API.
summary.outcome: Fixed the strict mode violations by adding :not(.upload-inline-row) to the getItem locator in file-list.page.ts, and fixed post-upload file visibility by wiring onUploadComplete to handleSync in FileBrowser.tsx. All previously-failing upload-related E2E suites now pass; two unrelated session persistence failures remain.

repo: The upload progress row uses both the file-list-item class AND a file-list-item-name span with the filename, so it matches getItem(name) locators — during the completion flash window, both the upload row and the real file row coexist briefly, causing Playwright strict mode violations.

getFileItem (distinct from getItem) filters out upload rows via hasNot: .file-list-item-size with text '-', but upload rows render '--' (double dash) for size, which still contains '-' so the filter was unreliable.

UploadZone has an onUploadComplete prop that was never wired in FileBrowser, so uploaded files only appeared on the next 30s IPNS sync poll rather than immediately — E2E tests previously masked this by treating the upload progress row as the 'visible file'.
IPNS sync is driven by a 30s polling interval in useSyncPolling.ts; handleSync resolves IPNS and refreshes the folder tree.
EmptyState has its own upload handling via useDropUpload directly and does not accept an onUploadComplete prop, so it is unaffected by the FileBrowser fix.

code.finding: getItem(name) locator was updated to add :not(.upload-inline-row) filter so it only matches settled file rows, not in-progress upload rows.
UploadZone was not receiving onUploadComplete; wired it to call actions.handleSync so a folder refresh is triggered immediately after each upload completes.
Upload row renders '--' (double dash) for the size field, not '-', which is distinct from folder entries but still caused confusion in hasNot text filters.
Exposes handleSync which can be called imperatively to trigger an immediate IPNS resolution and folder refresh outside of the 30s poll cycle.

workflow: E2E tests that depend on prior authentication steps cannot be run in isolation — they must be run as part of the full suite from the beginning.
A stale dev server pointing at localhost:3000 was already running on port 5173; it needed to be killed before starting a staging-pointed server, causing login failures mid-investigation.
Checking CI job logs for the specific failure pattern (strict mode violation: resolved to 2 elements) was enough to identify the root cause before reproducing locally.

friction: UploadListItem.tsx was read three times in sequence, suggesting difficulty finding the relevant size rendering code.
A pre-existing dev server on port 5173 (pointing at localhost:3000) silently intercepted the E2E tests, causing login failures that looked like auth regressions until the port conflict was diagnosed.

The uploadFile helper previously resolved immediately by matching the upload progress row, masking the real problem (no post-upload folder refresh) — the fix exposed the underlying IPNS sync latency issue.
handleSync required multiple grep passes to locate because it is accessed via an actions object rather than being directly exported.
open_items: Session persistence is lost after page reload when running E2E tests against staging — the 'Page reload preserves session and reloads root folder' test (3.7) and writable-shares tests fail with an unexpected login page.
EmptyState handles uploads via useDropUpload directly and has no onUploadComplete hook — files uploaded from an empty folder state may still not appear immediately until the next sync poll.

The upload row using the same file-list-item CSS class as real file rows is a structural ambiguity; a data-uploading attribute or a dedicated CSS class would be a cleaner long-term fix than relying on :not(.upload-inline-row) in every locator.
